recognize_zh: PAX8 染色中，大型異型細胞與背景小淋巴球的細胞核都呈棕色陽性；因為多株 PAX8 抗體會與 B 細胞的 PAX5 交叉反應，這個陽性不代表腎或甲狀腺癌轉移。
features: Nuclear PAX8 staining of large atypical cells with enlarged round nuclei (upper left)
Nuclear PAX8 staining also in a dense population of small background lymphocytes (lower right)
PAX8-negative stromal/histiocytic cells with blue counterstain
Staining of normal B cells indicates cross-reactivity (polyclonal PAX8 antibody recognizing PAX5)
describe_en: PAX8 immunohistochemistry shows nuclear staining of the large atypical cells as well as of numerous small background lymphocytes, while stromal cells are negative. Positivity in non-neoplastic small B cells indicates cross-reactivity of the PAX8 antibody (particularly polyclonal clones) with the PAX5 epitope rather than true epithelial PAX8 expression. This is a recognized pitfall that can lead to a misdiagnosis of metastatic renal, thyroid, or Mullerian carcinoma. In context with CD45 and PAX5 positivity, the findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma with cross-reactive PAX8 staining.

ddx.vs: RCC is PAX8+ but also keratin+/CD10+ and CD45/PAX5 negative, and background lymphocytes would not stain with a monoclonal PAX8 antibody.
These co-express keratin with TTF-1/thyroglobulin or WT1/ER, respectively, and lack hematolymphoid markers.
Repeating with a monoclonal PAX8 antibody that does not cross-react with PAX5 should render the lymphoma cells negative.
